items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: this bandleader and Jim Wynne said, 'Man, what are you doing here? Don't you know you're a father? You ought to be home.'

ctx.x: milk at that time and he would take the milk out there to see him.

The one thing that really broke my heart was when my husband went out to -- when he went out to see -- when he came home -- I must tell you this, this is funny. Well, we were working at this hotel, as I told you, and my husband was working at the theater downtown, would stop by the hotel sometimes at night and would ride home. Would ride home, you know, with us, see, because we didn't have a car at that time, so he would ride home with us because he had to transfer from the Carthay Circle Theater bus to the…

So they said, "Man, don't you know? What are you doing here?" And he came looking for me, and they said, "You're a daddy. You've got a son." He didn't even know. So he ran, and when he got home he ran up the steps, you know, and here I was, you know. And he says, "Why didn't you have somebody to call and tell me?" I said, "No, I didn't want to excite you because I knew you'd be home later." You know. And I says, "I was all right, you know."
